artworks.culture: Buddhist; Maurya and late Shunga periods
artworks.period: Mauryan origins and later Shunga/Satavahana enlargement
artworks.artistCulture: Buddhist patrons, builders and relief sculptors; individual makers unrecorded
artworks.medium: Stone masonry; sandstone facing on dome
artworks.function: 舍利 reliquary 纪念佛陀并支持 clockwise circumambulation；信徒在外围绕行，不进入实心穹丘作会众礼拜。
artworks.form: 半球 anda、围栏 vedika、四座 torana 与顶部 chatra 组合成宇宙秩序；下层与上层绕行道组织身体移动。
artworks.content: 门上以 Jataka 本生故事、树、轮与空座等符号叙述佛教；路径旁后加的人形佛像不等于早期门雕都采用人形佛。
artworks.context: Ashoka 时期起建，后世包覆扩建并增门；今日组合包含多个营造阶段，不能全定为公元前三世纪。
recognitionAnchors: 半球实心穹丘与顶部三重伞 chatra

artworks.function: 以 funerary army 守护帝陵，延续皇帝死后权威；庞大劳力组织也显示现世国家控制。
artworks.form: 近真人尺度、重复军阵与模制部件形成标准化；发式、面部与服装手工修整产生差异，原有彩绘 polychromy。
artworks.content: 步兵、弓手、军官与马构成军阵；现存裸陶色不代表原始外观，不能把所有差异断言为真人肖像。
artworks.context: 统一后的 Qin 国家把标准化与巨型工程相连；1974 年发现的俑坑只是陵区一部分，不等于已打开皇帝墓室。

artworks.form: T-shaped 丝幅横向分层，流动龙身连接上下；细线与重叠人物营造空间，不是木漆棺本身。
artworks.content: 天界日月与神灵、中间持杖的 Lady Dai 和侍从、下方祭奠及地下生物构成宇宙图式。
artworks.context: 出土于 Mawangdui Tomb 1，原置内棺之上；AP 约180 B.C.E.是课程标识，考古讨论可采用更宽二世纪范围；墓地不证明绘画作坊位置。

artworks.content: 必须看全崖、护法和卢舍那佛群；弟子、bodhisattva 与天王不是同一种身份。
artworks.context: 493 年始于 Northern Wei，唐代奉先寺为重点；CED 唐代标签不表示所有洞窟均唐建，早期与后期风格及赞助需区分。

artworks.provenanceQualifier: Smarthistory identifies the excavated burial context; this does not establish the precise goldworking workshop.
artworks.function: 王族 ceremonial regalia 表明地位，也进入墓葬延续死后身份；不能因金片脆弱就断言只为陪葬。
artworks.form: 薄金片树形与鹿角形竖饰、悬垂金圆片及逗号形 gogok 玉饰营造轻盈闪动表面。
artworks.content: 自然形态常联系 sacred tree、丰饶与萨满传统；这些是图像解释，不应把每一支都等同某个已证实的神。
artworks.context: 出土为 Gyeongju Hwangnam Daechong 北 mound；新罗贵重金属与欧亚交流并存，墓葬发现地不等于已知制作作坊。

artworks.function: 由 Shomu 皇帝赞助，作为国家寺院网络中心，借 Buddhist protection 组织精神及政治统一。

artworks.content: Great Buddha 为 Vairocana；Nio Agyo 开口、Ungyo 闭口守门。佛像、殿与门及两尊护法均须分辨。
artworks.context: 743 是发愿／造像起点，752 开眼；火灾后多次修复，现殿1709建成；1203护法属于Kamakura而非743原作。

artworks.workType: Royal temple and urban sacred complex
artworks.function: Angkor Wat 原奉 Vishnu 并体现王权；Angkor Thom 和 Bayon 的 Jayavarman VII 佛教营造不同，不把整个条目仅解释为一种宗教。
artworks.form: 吴哥窟五塔、轴线、围廊与护城河表现 Mount Meru 宇宙；Bayon 的面塔及吴哥城南门属于另一组城市构件。
artworks.content: Churning of Ocean of Milk 浮雕显示神魔拉 naga 求甘露；Bayon 面孔有佛／菩萨／王者解释，CED的Jayavarman VII as Buddha标签不排除学术争论。
artworks.context: 吴哥窟主要十二世纪早期，吴哥城和Bayon十二世纪晚期起；c.800–1400涵盖长期发展。两张plan分别是寺庙与地区布局，不能合并。

artworks.culture: Chinese; Northern Song landscape painting
artworks.artistCulture: Fan Kuan
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The landscape evokes northern Chinese mountains; neither its depicted setting nor its present collection proves an exact production site.
artworks.function: 以山水 landscape 鉴赏与沉思自然，强调人相对宇宙的尺度；不是某次旅行的精确地图。
artworks.form: 巨峰占上部，前景巨石、中景树群与溪流分层；cun纹理笔法、墨色浓淡与云雾空白连接近远。
artworks.content: 底部极小商旅驮队与壮阔山体对比；细瀑从高峰垂下，观众视线在多个空间层次游动。
artworks.context: Northern Song绘画以自然观察和山水理想结合；可能联系道家宇宙观，但不能将便携画的现收藏地或描绘景观当作确定作坊。
recognitionAnchors: 占绝大画幅的中央巨峰

comparisonNotes.ap211-great-wave: 两者对比渺小人群与强大自然；Fan Kuan用墨色纹理和垂直巨峰，Hokusai用彩色木刻、近景波峰与远小富士。

artworks.culture: Hindu; Chola dynasty, Tamil Nadu
artworks.artistCulture: Chola bronze casters; individual maker unrecorded
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The precise casting workshop and original temple are not established by the CED; this is a regional creation-context anchor.
artworks.function: 作为可供装扮、礼拜及procession的神像，使Shiva向信众显现；不只是静态美术馆装饰。
artworks.form: lost-wax casting塑成四臂舞动身体，火焰aureole围合；一足踩侏儒，一足举起，平衡同时表达动能。
artworks.content: 鼓象征创造，火象征毁灭；abhaya手示无畏，另一手指向举足的解脱；Apasmara代表无知。
artworks.context: Chola赞助南印度寺院青铜，宇宙循环与信众实践相连；确切作坊及原庙未知，以Tamil Nadu区域定位。

artworks.titleEn: Night Attack on the Sanjô Palace
artworks.artistCulture: Japanese handscroll painter; individual maker unrecorded
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The narrative depicts the Sanjo Palace attack in Kyoto in 1159; the depicted event is not proof of the later handscroll's production workshop.
artworks.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
artworks.function: 供精英逐段展卷观看gunki monogatari战争故事，纪念并塑造对武士与宫廷冲突的历史记忆。
artworks.form: emaki从右向左渐展，骑兵、屋顶斜线、火焰与人流形成节奏；时间靠观看动作推进，不是一次看全的壁画。
artworks.content: 叙述1159袭击Sanjo Palace、纵火混战及劫持退位皇帝Go-Shirakawa；必看开头文字与骑手而不只火场。
artworks.context: 画于事件后约一世纪，反映Kamakura武士时代的回顾；京都的故事现场不能证明后来绘卷的制作作坊。
recognitionAnchors: 红黑火焰和斜向宫殿屋顶

comparisonNotes.ap212-mao-anyuan: 两者回顾历史以塑造政治记忆；Sanjo以连续多人物行动讲冲突，Mao印刷品以单一理想化英雄压缩革命历史。

artworks.culture: Chinese; Yuan dynasty porcelain
artworks.period: Fourteenth-century Yuan ceramic production and exchange
artworks.artistCulture: Jingdezhen porcelain workshop; donor Zhang Wenjin named in inscriptions
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The anchor represents porcelain production at Jingdezhen, not the later temple dedication or present London collection.
artworks.workType: Pair of inscribed temple altar vases
artworks.function: 与香炉组成temple altar供器，为Daoist temple奉献祈求家人平安；不是本来为London藏家制作。
artworks.form: 白瓷以cobalt蓝釉下彩绘，透明釉与高温烧造增亮；长颈、象耳、鼓腹与分带纹饰组成成对器形。
artworks.content: dragon、phoenix、花叶及长铭文结合；铭文记录1351和供养者，象鼻环部损失是保存状态，不是另一设计。
artworks.context: Jingdezhen制造与西亚钴料交换体现Mongol网络；Yuan并非Ming，制作地、寺院奉献地和现收藏地须分开。

comparisonNotes.ap196-gold-jade-crown: 两者以贵重材料和细工表现精英资源；David Vases服务寺院供养并体现跨区钴料交换，Silla冠服务身体服饰与墓葬。

artworks.culture: Korean; Joseon dynasty Confucian court portraiture
artworks.artistCulture: Imperial Bureau of Painting; individual artist unrecorded
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The CED identifies the court painting bureau, not an exact workshop address; the national court context is used rather than the present shrine location.
artworks.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
artworks.function: honor meritorious subject表彰功臣与忠诚，后代保存并用于祖先纪念；不是普通无名官员肖像。
artworks.form: 全身坐姿与微侧脸、藏袖双手、空背景形成克制礼仪；面部细节比衣袍更个别化。
artworks.content: Sin Sukju戴黑帽、穿官袍，rank badge双孔雀示文官等级；椅与脚凳强化正式身份。
artworks.context: Joseon儒家秩序重忠臣和祖先；CED称Imperial Bureau，历史解释可称royal bureau；现家族祠藏地不证明绘制地点。

comparisonNotes.ap208-jahangir-sufi-shaikh: 同以画像建构政治等级；Sin以克制坐姿与徽章表现文官功勋，Jahangir以光环和人物大小表现皇权与精神优先。

artworks.culture: Chinese; Ming and Qing imperial courts
artworks.period: Fifteenth-century Ming palace with Qing additions
artworks.artistCulture: Imperial architects and craftspeople; Ming Yongle and later Qing patrons
artworks.medium: Stone masonry, marble, brick, wood and ceramic tile
artworks.workType: Imperial palace and ceremonial residential complex
artworks.function: 宫廷礼仪、统治与皇室居住按rank分区；外朝与内廷把国家及家庭等级转为空间秩序。
artworks.form: 南北axis、连续门与院落、抬高殿基及木构瓦顶组织递进；红墙黄瓦和龙纹强化帝权。
artworks.content: 必看鸟瞰、Tiananmen、Hall of Supreme Harmony、plan及宁寿宫相关illusionistic interior；画墙天花制造虚拟建筑花园，不能换成任意殿厅。
artworks.context: 主体1406–1420营造，Qing持续使用修建；乾隆退休空间为十八世纪层次，后世修复不等于Ming原件。CED front gate照片为天安门，不是午门。
recognitionAnchors: 宁寿宫相关透视壁画与天花

comparisonNotes.ap209-taj-mahal: 两者用轴线对称和等级通行表达帝权；Forbidden City是持续政务住宅，Taj Mahal是纪念性墓园。

artworks.culture: Japanese; Zen Buddhism, Muromachi foundation and later garden history
artworks.period: Muromachi temple; likely eighteenth-century current garden design
artworks.artistCulture: Garden designer unrecorded; attribution uncertain
artworks.date: c. 1480 C.E.; current design most likely eighteenth century C.E.
artworks.medium: Rock garden; rocks, gravel, moss, walls; pond garden
artworks.function: 供观看与contemplation，Zen语境强调注意力；不能证明每颗石头有唯一固定教义，也不把所有观众当僧人。
artworks.form: dry garden以十五石、苔岛、耙纹gravel和低墙形成不对称；另有实际水池wet garden，plan展示二者关系。
artworks.content: 枯山水可唤起山、水与岛的意象，却没有真实流水；观看点变化使石群可见关系变化，开放解释。
artworks.context: 寺院早期历史与现存设计年代不同；CED保留c.1480并说明现设计很可能十八世纪，不能把今天全部定为十五世纪。
recognitionAnchors: 围墙内十五石与耙纹白砾
苔藓石岛与大面积留白

artworks.culture: Mughal India; Islamic court culture and cross-cultural painting
artworks.titleEn: Jahangir Preferring a Sufi Shaikh to Kings
artworks.titleZh: 贾汉吉尔偏爱苏菲圣贤胜于诸王
artworks.artistCulture: Bichitr
artworks.provenanceQualifier: Bichitr's court context is established, but the CED does not fix the city where this portable album painting was made.
artworks.medium: Watercolor, gold and ink on paper
artworks.function: 以muraqqa album供宫廷赏鉴；宣示皇帝优先尊重精神圣贤，同时把自己置于全球统治者之上。
artworks.form: hierarchical scale使皇帝最大，日月金halo与沙漏宝座表现宇宙时间；细笔、金饰和花边框成豪华整页。
artworks.content: 皇帝向Sufi shaikh赠书，下列Ottoman ruler、James I与画家自画像；putti和欧洲式人物借外来视觉语汇。
artworks.context: 非真实同场接见纪录，而是symbolic hierarchy；Bichitr为Hindu画家服务Mughal，说明艺术传统不等于作者宗教。
recognitionAnchors: 沙漏座上的皇帝与赠书圣贤
下列诸王、画家及装饰边框

artworks.culture: Mughal India; Islamic funerary and garden architecture
artworks.artistCulture: Ustad Ahmad Lahori supervising masons, marble workers, mosaicists and decorators
artworks.medium: Stone masonry and marble with precious and semiprecious stone inlay; gardens
artworks.function: Shah Jahan为Mumtaz Mahal建陵，兼具爱情纪念、王朝荣耀及paradise园林意象；不只是住宅或清真寺。
artworks.form: 白大理石穹顶、四角minaret与轴向水池形成对称；charbagh花园分区，镶嵌pietra dura与经文精工装饰。
artworks.content: 室内cenotaph为象征棺，实际墓葬在下层；marble screen、花卉镶嵌及书法装饰把外部纪念性转为近观细节。
artworks.context: 1632–1653范围涵盖陵园多部分，后来Shah Jahan也葬入；Mughal整合伊斯兰与地方工匠传统，现修复不得等于原始完工。
recognitionAnchors: 白色葱形穹顶与四角尖塔

artworks.culture: Japanese; Edo-period Rinpa painting
artworks.artistCulture: Ogata Korin
artworks.provenanceQualifier: Ogata Korin worked in Kyoto and Edo; the CED does not establish a precise studio for these screens. Atami is the present collection, not the creation site.
artworks.medium: Ink, watercolor and gold leaf on paper
artworks.function: byobu屏风分隔并装饰室内，以昂贵金底与季节自然服务鉴赏；不是固定拉门或单幅纵轴。
artworks.form: 两屏共构波曲溪流，平面金底与自然树身并置；tarashikomi湿色叠染形成树干斑纹，水纹高度抽象。
artworks.content: 左屏白梅较苍老，右屏红梅较年轻，溪流把分离屏面关联；必看两屏而非任意一树局部。
artworks.context: Rinpa是后世称呼的松散设计传统，不是Korin创办正式学院；艺术家活动于Kyoto和Edo，现Atami馆藏不等于工作室。
recognitionAnchors: 中间曲流与树干斑驳湿染

comparisonNotes.ap211-great-wave: 同将自然化为强烈平面设计；Korin的金地手绘屏风供室内精英观看，Hokusai彩色木版印刷流通于城市市场。

artworks.culture: Japanese; Edo-period ukiyo-e print culture
artworks.titleEn: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as the Great Wave, from the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji
artworks.artistCulture: Katsushika Hokusai; collaborative woodblock production
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The anchor represents the print's Edo publishing context, not the depicted waters off Kanagawa.
artworks.medium: Polychrome woodblock print; ink and color on paper
artworks.workType: Commercial landscape print from a series
artworks.function: ukiyo-e商业版画为城市购买者提供富士与旅行景观；可复印多份，不是唯一油画。
artworks.form: 巨大近景波峰以爪状白沫包住小小远方Fuji；曲线、斜向舟与Prussian blue形成动静及近远对比。
artworks.content: 三艘长舟与俯身船员面临巨浪，远山稳定；无需把波浪认定为一次有记录tsunami。
artworks.context: Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji呼应旅游及圣山兴趣；欧洲透视与进口蓝色参与跨文化交换，Edo出版地不同于Kanagawa描绘水域。

artworks.culture: People's Republic of China; Cultural Revolution propaganda
artworks.titleEn: Chairman Mao en Route to Anyuan
artworks.artistCulture: Artist unknown; based on Liu Chunhua's 1967 oil painting
artworks.siteName: China (Cultural Revolution print production; workshop unknown)
artworks.provenanceQualifier: The specified work is an anonymous circa-1969 lithograph after Liu Chunhua's painting. Anyuan is the depicted destination, not a documented printing location; Beijing is not asserted as the anonymous print's workshop.
artworks.function: 以color lithograph广泛复制个人崇拜，塑造Mao为革命源头及群众引领者；本条目是印刷品不是1967油画原作。
artworks.form: 单一理想化英雄居中高大，低地平线、亮面与风动长衫强化前行；云雾山水结合socialist realism的人物塑造。
artworks.content: 年轻Mao携伞走向Anyuan；图像叙事指1921赴安源，随后1922矿工罢工为背景，不能把两年事件合成同一刻。
artworks.context: 源自Liu Chunhua的1967油画，CED指定约1969匿名lithograph；文革宣传重写革命功劳，不把画家、展地或Anyuan当作匿名印刷作坊。
recognitionAnchors: 高大中心人像与云雾群山
